_comment: One object per LIVE agent. strategy_wallet from tracker get_wallets; user_id from arena_leaderboard.entries[].senpiUserId; producer_signature = the MCP scan tool(s) the producer calls every tick — enumerate with: grep -nE 'mcp_call\(' <agent>/scripts/<agent>-producer.py. The signature is how SILENT (dead scanner) is distinguished from a runtime that is merely still polling clearinghouse_state.
